title: Saturday: budget overtime and COP31 finale
intro: Metro still shut through tomorrow evening; politicians keep talking budgets and climate negotiators run into overtime in Turkey.

big-news.text: Budget talks missed Friday's self-imposed deadline and continue on overtime. Disagreements include fuel taxes, climate spending, municipal funding and Norgespris.
COP31 in Antalya was due to end yesterday but negotiations continue. Norway joined France and Panama in pushing for stronger language on moving away from fossil fuels in the final text.

oslo.text: T-bane shutdown day three of four. Check Ruter before heading out — buses and trams remain crowded.
Oslo Labour holds weekend meetings to adopt a new municipal programme and nominate mayoral candidates (Mushtaq vs Skarstein).

be-aware.text: Norway was named "Fossil of the Day" at COP31 by climate activists — symbolic criticism of Norway's oil and gas policy, not a government award.

fun-and-free.text: Barnas Verksted at Sentralen — free drop-in art workshop for young kids, Sat–Sun 11:00–16:00 in Vinterhagen.
CC Cowboys at Sentrum Scene tonight at 19:00 — veteran Norwegian rock if you want a warm venue after a cold walk.
